name: accordion
description: An accordion is a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title and a content area.

documentBlocks.content: An accordion is a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title and a content area.

Single vs. multiple expansion.

By default, only one accordion item may be expanded at a time. However, the component can be configured to allow multiple items to remain open simultaneously.

Title wrapping.

Accordion titles wrap automatically if they exceed the available width.

Optional actions.

An optional action button or switch can be placed on the trailing edge of an accordion item to support contextual interactions.

Progressive disclosure.

Accordions are effective for organizing large amounts of related content within a limited space. They help users stay focused by revealing information only when it's needed, making them ideal for scenarios where not all content needs to be visible at once.

documentBlocks.dont: Avoid using accordions when users are likely to read all the content in one go, as they can introduce unnecessary clicks and hinder the user experience. For complex or deeply nested information structures, consider alternative components such as tree views or tabs to maintain clarity and ease of navigation

implementations.notes: Spectrum 2 web component custom element: swc-accordion.

isOpen.description: Whether the rendered accordion item is expanded. Drives the chevron direction and the content area. Per-item expansion in a data-driven accordion is items[].isExpanded.

content.description: The text shown in the content area of the rendered accordion item while it is expanded. Per-item in a data-driven accordion is items[].content.

hasActionButton.description: Whether the rendered accordion item shows an icon-only action button on its trailing edge. Per-item in a data-driven accordion is items[].hasActionButton.

hasSwitch.description: Whether the rendered accordion item shows a switch on its trailing edge. Per-item in a data-driven accordion is items[].hasSwitch.

label.description: The text label displayed for the accordion item.

content.description: The content shown when the accordion item is expanded.

isExpanded.description: Whether the accordion item is expanded by default.

hasSwitch.description: If true, the accordion item includes a switch.

hasActionButton.description: If true, the accordion item includes an action button.

isMultiple.description: If true, multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The accordion items. Each entry of the items option is drawn as one copy of the accordion-item part.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Direct actions on the trailing edge of the item header.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Content shown below the header while the item is open.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: The accordion itself: a column of accordion items. It is the root and sets the width and minimum width; the items fill it.

anatomy.name: container-divider
anatomy.description: One-pixel line that opens the list, above the first item. It belongs to the container, not to an item, and fills the container's width. Absent when the accordion is quiet (isQuiet).

anatomy.name: accordion-item
anatomy.description: One accordion item: a header, the content area while open, and the divider below. It repeats once per entry of the items option and fills the container's width.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Row holding the disclosure icon, the title and the optional actions. It is the interactive heading.

anatomy.name: disclosure-icon
anatomy.description: Chevron at the start of the header. It points to the end while the item is closed and down while it is open.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Text label of the item. It wraps when it exceeds the available width.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Row on the trailing edge of the header that holds the optional action button and switch. Absent when neither is shown.

anatomy.name: action-button
anatomy.description: Icon-only action button (the action-button component) in the actions. Shown when hasActionButton is on.

anatomy.name: switch
anatomy.description: Switch (the switch component) in the actions. Shown when hasSwitch is on.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Area below the header holding the item's content. Shown only while the item is open (isOpen).

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: One-pixel line below the item. Absent when the accordion is quiet (isQuiet).

anatomy.name: focus-indicator
anatomy.description: Outline for keyboard focus on the header.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web accordion page, React Spectrum S2 Accordion and SWC gen2 swc-accordion. item renamed accordion-item (all three sources and the registry). The container part is the recipe root and repeats accordion-item once per entry; it owns the Width (default) and minimum-width records and the items fill it (React Spectrum puts minWidth on the item and has no styled container, so that is a Figma-frame reading). direct-actions renamed actions (registry term; SWC slot actions); it stays a part because the recipe lays it out as a row. No trigger-button part: the button React Spectrum and SWC wrap around chevron and title is not a layer in Figma, so rounding and background sit on accordion-item. disclosure-icon kept (picker uses it). focus-indicator is state-only. Divider kept as a part (Figma Divider instance); small-divider removed from the registry. container-divider is the divider that opens the list: Figma's Accordion has one Divider instance above the item slot (no gap or padding between it and the first item), and each item keeps its own end divider, so it follows Figma; React Spectrum S2 draws the top line as a per-item border instead. actions group kept as a layout/slot part (row with its own gap); relies on the anatomy-format amendment tracked in spectrum-design-data-5m92.8.
